name: duckdb_list_tables
description:
Lists the tables in the DuckDB sandbox with row counts. Each CSV, TSV, Parquet and JSON file in the DuckDB data folder (data.duckdb.dir, default data/duckdb) is a table named after the file (orders.csv is orders), in an in-memory sandbox with no file or URL access; changed files are reloaded automatically.
Returns {tables, total_count}: each table is {name, type (table or view), schema, row_count}.
Inputs: include_system_tables (boolean; default false; true adds tables outside the main schema).
For columns use duckdb_describe_table; for the files behind the tables duckdb_list_files.
Example: {"include_system_tables": false}

include_system_tables.description: Include system/internal tables in the listing

tables.description: List of available tables and views

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Lists all tables and views available for querying in DuckDB

examples.description: List all tables including system tables
